PG_candidate_selection: Freeze only after full20k calibration and fresh-seed confirmation; no new heldout-driven parameter selection.
preserve_original_scoring: Use original stage ensembles,200bagsx400cellsx4stages,two generationreplicates and fixed1500generated/1500real pooled PCA50 reservoir. Do not substitute the four-donor calibration equal-stage reservoir.
primary_statistic: Equal-fold mean of cell_energy_distance; average generationreplicates then trainingseeds within fold. Report all15seed-by-fold values as well.

uncertainty.unit: Real-donor clusters within each fold/stage; generated reservoirs and fitted-model states fixed. Preserve unequal realcell counts by ratio of resampled cross-sums to resampled cell counts.
uncertainty.pairing: Identical real target reservoirs across compared methods. Real-real term cancels exactly. Average paired model/replicate components before resampling real donors.
uncertainty.real_reservoir_donor_identity: Reconstruct original1500 target-reservoir row indices with the original20261026 RNG and unchanged evaluation metadata; verify exact equality to saved real_cell_reservoir. Require all intended evaluation donor clusters present or report the interval unavailable; never silently drop donors.
uncertainty.seed_variability: Report every paired training-seed distance difference separately; do not treat seeds/cells/replicates as biological donors.
uncertainty.limitations: Fixed-model/reservoir conditional uncertainty, historically exposed cohort and overlapping fitting folds; not independent population confirmation.

claim_rules.distribution_comparison: Completed required matrix, lower mean pooled distance than each of three matched comparators, all three Bonferroni paired-contrast upper bounds below0; show foldwise and seedwise consistency.
claim_rules.quality_tradeoffs: Always report donor energy, coverage and total/within-condition spread; disclose any deterioration and any failure of the0.7..1.3 spread guard. A numerical distance win with collapsed donor spread is not an unqualified generative-quality win.
claim_rules.SOTA_scope: Best among tested, disclosed fixed/tuned comparator recipes on this ALZ protocol only if supported. Broad universal or independent-cohort SOTA remains unsupported without corresponding evidence.

comparator_readiness_gaps: Existing matched CFGen caller hardcodes fold0/seed0/cell count14762 and must be generalized and qualified for all frozen folds/seeds before45cell execution.
Current historical PG/scVI-only aggregate is donor-energy primary and excludes CFGen; it cannot substantiate the new distribution-primary goal unchanged.
Comparator calibration settings and any tuning budgets must be disclosed and frozen before new heldout evaluation; historical tuning effort differs.
